scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Whoa, long time no see! But weren't you supposed to be dead?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
哇，好久不见！
不过，你不是已经死了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Ah, you must have been reborn. Well, I'm glad to have you back.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
啊，原来你转生了。
很高兴你能回来。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
I'm sorry, but I don't think you're ready to learn magic yet. Why don't you go finish learning the Basic Skills first?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
抱歉，你还没准备好学习魔法。
不如先去把基本技能学完吧？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Take your time. The more you learn, the more ready you'll be to learn magic again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
慢慢来。
多学些东西，才能为重新学习魔法做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Well, since you have passed the Mage test once, I will not question your qualification. You want to have your magic skills back immediately, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
既然你已经通过一次魔法师考试，我就不再质疑你的资格了。
你想马上恢复魔法能力，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wow, for some reason, you look way better than you did before. Anyway, I believe you will do a better job being a Mage as well.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
哇，不知道为什么，你看起来比以前好看多了。
总之，我相信你也会成为更出色的魔法师。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Is there anything more I can help you with? If not, why don't you go test your skills? The world is waiting for you~!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
还有什么需要我帮忙的吗？
没有的话，就去试试你的本领吧。
这个世界正等着你呢~！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
What, are you interested in the Mage guild? I didn't want to tell you this, but you don't belong here.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
怎么，你对魔法师公会感兴趣？
我本来不想说的，可这里不是你该来的地方。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
I am not sure why you're still standing in front of me, but I can tell that you're not meant to be a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
不知道你为什么还站在我面前，不过我看得出来，你不适合当魔法师。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey, haven't you realized? You're already a Mage, silly!
One of these days you'll realize the power inside of you when you can make Fire with your mind!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嘿，你还没发现吗？你已经是魔法师了，傻瓜！
总有一天，当你能用意念生出火焰时，你就会意识到自己体内的力量！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey~ C'mon. Quit playing games. You can't be a Mage because you already have another Job.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嘿~别闹了。
你已经有其他职业，不能再当魔法师了。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嘿？

scripts.text: I want to be a Mage
scripts.translation: 我想成为魔法师

scripts.text: What are the requirements to be a Mage?
scripts.translation: 成为魔法师需要什么条件？

scripts.text: Nothing, thanks.
scripts.translation: 没什么，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage? Eh...
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
想成为魔法师？呃...

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey, look at you! You're kinda cute~! Not my type though...
Right, you said that you wanna be a Mage?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嘿，瞧瞧你！还挺可爱的~！不过不是我喜欢的类型...
对了，你说你想成为魔法师？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Oooh, you're such a hot babe~!
I like girls like you~
Right, you said that you wanna be a Mage?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
噢噢，你真是个大美女~！
我就喜欢你这样的女孩~
对了，你说你想成为魔法师？

scripts.text: I want to be a Mage.
scripts.translation: 我想成为魔法师

scripts.text: Nothing, thanks.
scripts.translation: 没什么，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Whaaaaat~?! Right after you tell me that you wanna become a Mage, you change your mind?! Be a bit more decisive!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
什么~~？！
刚说完想当魔法师，你就改主意了？！
果断一点嘛！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Oh, man your Basic Skill Level doesn't reach enough to be a Mage.
Go back and level up your Basic Skill.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
哎呀，你的基本技能等级还不够当魔法师。
回去把基本技能练上去吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Alright.. sign the application form.... Wow~ you have good handwriting! Ahh, okay. That's enough.
You are... {0}.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
好吧...在申请表上签名...哇~ 你的字写得真好！啊，好了，可以了。
你是...{0}。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hmm I can see that you've tried hard in your own way. Though it seems to be a little clumsy, but well I think it's okay!
Good! Always sticking to the basics is the best! I will transform you right away.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嗯，看得出你用自己的方式努力过了。虽然看起来有点笨拙，不过我觉得没问题！
很好！始终坚持基础才是最好的！我这就为你转职。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hahh..! You are now a Mage, one of our colleagues!
We welcome you to the Mage Guild, our new friend!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
哈啊...！你现在是魔法师了，是我们的同伴！
欢迎加入魔法师公会，新朋友！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
'Welcome to the Mage Guild~'
Congratulations on becoming a member of the Mage Guild! Go for it!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
“欢迎加入魔法师公会~”
恭喜你成为魔法师公会的一员！加油吧！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage, eh?
I'd be happy to explain the requirements for a pretty girl like you!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
想当魔法师啊？
为你这样漂亮的女孩说明转职条件，我当然乐意！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
First of all, you have to reach Novice Job Level 10 and learn all of the Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
首先，初心者的职业等级必须达到10级，并学会所有基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
In the past, there was a complicated potion making test. Because of that, we'd lost an aplicant slowly.
So, we decided to accept all aplicants who meet the basic requirements.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
以前有个复杂的药剂制作考试。因此，申请者越来越少。
所以，我们决定接受所有满足基本条件的申请者。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Don't hesitate. Just be a magician!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
别犹豫了。来当魔法师吧！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Nothing...?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
没什么事...？
